cases.name: 02-aliased
cases.notes: Aliases (`as`) still resolve to the original exported name.

cases.name: 03-default-import
cases.notes: Default exports resolve under the conventional symbol name `default`.

cases.name: 04-namespace
cases.notes: v1 DEFERRED: namespace imports require member-access resolution (`m.add`), which is outside the import-bound precision boundary. T1-B should NOT emit references here.

cases.name: 05-shadowing
cases.notes: Only the outer use binds to the imported `add`. The shadowed `const add` inside `shadowed()` rebinds locally and MUST NOT be counted.

cases.name: 06-re-export
cases.notes: One-hop re-export is tracked. Transitive (2+ hop) re-export chains are out of scope for v1.

cases.name: 07-side-effect
cases.notes: Side-effect-only imports bind no symbols; zero expected references.

cases.name: 08-type-only
cases.notes: Type-only imports are still import-bound references.

cases.name: 09-string-literal
cases.notes: The string literal `"add and multiply"` MUST NOT produce a reference even though `add` appears in it.

cases.name: 10-unused
cases.notes: Imported but never referenced. Zero expected references. T1-B may emit the import edge, but no reference rows.
